name: browsy-bot
description: Zero-middleware Chrome DevTools Protocol plugin for OpenCode. Navigate, screenshot, and evaluate page JS in live tabs — no Puppeteer, no Playwright. Auto-discovers page targets and learns selectors, quirks, and flows across sessions via memorius.
description_zh: 零中间件 Chrome DevTools 协议浏览器自动化。CDP 核心加适配器：OpenCode 插件、MCP 服务器、CLI。使用 memorius 驱动的学习，在实时标签页中导航、截图和评估页面 JS。
